response.overview: Beneath the surface, the ocean is anything but silent. Waves, boat engines, marine animals communicating, the cracking of the icepack and the running water of its steady melting form a soundscape captured during a polar research mission. Those recordings become the basis of an electronic score and an animated underwater world — dark and enigmatic, sparsely inhabited by synthetic forms — whose gradual disturbance carries the film through its imagined depths.
response.title: Écosystème
